== Summary ==
[[Thomas McGee]] at the [[2009 World Championship]], Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey, 10 October 2009. Crop of [[:File:2009 World Championship Veez schoe McGee Clark.jpg]] ("Mr. McGee").

== Source ==
Photo by Flickr user punkybear (forum user Nibcrom), album "philly and jersey worlds": [https://www.flickr.com/photos/punkybear/4096154247/ we got Veez and schoe n the backgrond and Mr. McGee and Mr. 'V or non-V' Clark ] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2434/4096154247_703c7b4009_b.jpg). Several were posted to the forum thread [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=31192 2009 Worlds pictures] (topic 31192), e.g. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=482550#p482550 post by Nibcrom], 12 November 2009. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
